description:
Apply a declarative edit to an existing subtree, PRESERVING the id of every node you keep (so variable bindings, instance overrides and prototype links survive) — the id-preserving alternative to delete+rebuild. Workflow: read_jsx({node}) → edit that JSX (keep id= on kept nodes, drop id= on new ones, re-nest freely) → reconcile_preview({scope, markup}) → reconcile_apply({scope, markup, previewToken, previewVersion, previewHash}). Pass the preview credential fields unchanged. The runtime rejects missing, expired, reused, mismatched, or stale-snapshot credentials before mutation.

Matching is by explicit id only: an id= node is updated/moved in place (re-parenting = move, id kept); a node with no id is created. Props are a PATCH — only props in the markup are written, absent props are left unchanged (never cleared). Existing nodes not in the markup are KEPT unless allowDelete:true. This tool remains experimental, deferred, sequential, capped, and non-atomic; narrow the scope so a partial result is recoverable.

allowDelete.description: When true, remove existing nodes absent from the markup. Default false — unmatched nodes are kept (safe patch).

markup.description: Target JSX for the desired subtree — same dialect as read_jsx output; keep id= on every node you want to KEEP

previewHash.description: Scope/target/live snapshot hash returned by reconcile_preview

previewToken.description: One-shot token returned by the matching reconcile_preview call

previewVersion.description: Preview contract version returned by reconcile_preview

scope.description: Node id of the existing subtree to reconcile (maps to the markup root)

name: reconcile_apply
